1981-2415-6798-6823.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-6798-6823.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2976-4772-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
2976-4772-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Animate Land
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

1263-4871-6255-6798.notablePrerequisites:
You have attacked this turn.
You have max speed.
1263-4871-6255-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Zahur trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a land you control

2092-4495-4954.description:
Activate the land with New Horizons attached by tapping it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping the land and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.
2092-4495-4954.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

4506-7690-7743--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4506-7690-7743--165.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2092-4659-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {2} at most due to Agatha, creating a token copy of another artifact you control with haste.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the artifact token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
2092-4659-7282.notes: You can make tokens of Krark-Clan Ironworks if desired.

2292-5220-6900-7286.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

4681-5170-5256-6634.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

3490-4050-6720-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-6720-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

413-539-7008.description:
Cast Badgermole Cub by paying its mana cost
When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Badgermole Cub trigger, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Badgermole Cub
When Badgermole Cub dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

2232-3542-5147-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
2232-3542-5147-6843.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Palinchron from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Palinchron enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Palinchron.
Repeat.

147-313-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-313-6797.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Corpse Dance.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Corpse Dance, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1669-2921-3234-3293.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1669-2921-3234-3293.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat
1669-2921-3234-3293.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2732-5147-6132.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

440-1339-1545-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-1545-4050.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

1912-2897-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Gigantoplasm has a power of at least 2.
1912-2897-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Gigantoplasm and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Gigantoplasm from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Gigantoplasm to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Gigantoplasm enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Gigantoplasm by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1770-4374-5870.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two energy counters.
1770-4374-5870.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
When Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E} and gain 2 life.
Repeat.

1479-4826-5671-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-4826-5671-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and The Necrobloom trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1379-1580-1636-1785.notablePrerequisites: Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
1379-1580-1636-1785.description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1110-2343-2440-3490.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal non-lethal damage to Siegehorn Ceratops.
1110-2343-2440-3490.description:
Deal damage to Siegehorn Ceratops.
Siegehorn Ceratops triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Terror of the Peaks and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Servo you control.
Resolve the Terror of the Peaks trigger, dealing 1 damage to Siegehorn Ceratops.
Repeat from step 2.

937-3591-4551.description:
During your upkeep, activate Necropotence by paying 1 life, exiling the top card of your library face down.
Repeat step 1 until you have zero life.
Activate Magus of the Mirror by tapping and sacrificing it, exchanging your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
